verdict.rationale: Crossmint documents order-lifecycle tracking mechanisms an agent could query: agent checkouts are poll-driven to a terminal state (no webhooks in v1), onramp orders can be retrieved by ID to track progress through KYC/verification/payment/delivery, and card order intents track total/reserved/spent/available amounts. However, agent checkouts explicitly lack webhooks and a staging environment, and there's no dedicated 'get agent checkout order status' endpoint shown analogous to the onramp get-order API. missing for 10: an explicit agent-checkout order-status/tracking endpoint, independent/hands-on confirmation that polling actually returns granular tracking info, and unified documentation tying post-purchase status querying directly to the agent-checkout product rather than onramp/offramp only.
